problems.what: (still open from round 1) Bolt fatigue safety factor is wrong by about 7x. The conclusion 'not controlling' survives only because the error is conservative.
problems.evidence: fatigue_sn(mode correction, alternating 3.08 MPa, mean 447 MPa, goodman, endurance 129 MPa, ultimate 800 MPa) -> safety_factor 1.716, data.assumptions 'Safety scales mean and amplitude together'.
